rules.rationale: This intermediate A13 change called __system_property_read with a null prop_info so bionic could synthesize selected missing properties. A13 fully reverted it later the same day. The final authoritative libbase behavior is to return default_value when the property does not exist.
rules.necessity: Not necessary and contrary to final A13 behavior. Missing-property virtualization that remains required is implemented inside the reviewed bionic compatibility boundary.
rules.performance: Avoids extra stack buffers and a libc compatibility call for every missing property lookup.
rules.security: Avoids deliberately passing a null property descriptor across the libc API and keeps generic libbase callers on the documented default-value contract.
validation_evidence: A13 commit 1d05b47e is an exact revert of 31bba9e8; final A13, AOSP16 and Android-16 all return default_value immediately for pi == nullptr.

target_state.assertion: missing property lookup returns the caller default without a null descriptor read
target_state.evidence: Current properties.cpp retains the immediate pi-null return used by the final A13 revert state.

rules.rationale: The complete A13 revert is preserved by the unchanged Android-16 implementation: an absent prop_info returns the caller-provided default and never enters the read callback path.
rules.necessity: Necessary to represent the final A13 decision and prevent resurrection of the unsafe intermediate hook.
rules.performance: Restores the constant-time missing-property fast path.
rules.security: Keeps property spoofing out of generic libbase and avoids a null descriptor call; bionic remains the single reviewed virtualization boundary.
validation_evidence: Final properties.cpp in all three trees was inspected and contains the same immediate null return.
